visual_review.notes: H3 video. The first idle and attack plates flash black and the first hit runs off the top of the frame, so all three were retaken; the second attack clipped the flame tip at the top and was retaken again with headroom. The idle loops on frames 36 to 96 of the retake, skipping the moment the staff turns upside down. The cast skips the frames where the staff flips upside down while rising and lowering and the halo around the staff head, so it snaps into the raise and back. The walk loops on frames 31 to 93.
